prior_evidence: interface-replication-001 selected interface passed its held-out engineering gate, but natural-peer effects were sparse. No prior negative timing/routing result is superseded or pooled.
purpose: Measure routing and verdict-disclosure history under a usable fixed answer-first interface, separate from mathematical capability failure. This is one component test, not a substitute for end-to-end natural-task and cross-model utility.
design: 12 fresh reliability-pair cells x two complements x copy/independent origins. 2208 real calls. All three agents privately assess one message; all receive the same unique evidence by S1. ST re-delivers two prior messages under fresh transport IDs with preserved origin IDs.
routing: Raw means all registered messages plus true lineage, not an uninformed strawman. Dedup retains the first representative per recipient/origin and renders neutral duplicate receipts. Exact calculator inputs are the same unique measurements in both policies. New independent origins with identical content are retained. Recipient ledger and strong canonical-ID dedup are one baseline, not two novelty claims.
timing: Open shows other agents' actual S0 answer fields at S1 and ST. Delay first releases those same reports at ST. Never withholds them at both rounds. Every method makes two assessments per agent. Actual S1 answers are not transmitted: this is frozen-report broadcast, not endogenous debate propagation. History effects bundle prior response state and disclosure schedule, not a pure latent cognitive mechanism.
common_adjudicator: Identical model, schema, sampling settings and seed across methods. Only terminal artifacts, no raw evidence, calculator, oracle or extra retrieval. Prescribed equal-weight pooling is a fixed engineering reference, not a learned evidence-quality aggregation method. Raw adjudicator outputs are retained and deviation from the specified mean is separately audited.
controls: Single agent with all unique evidence plus common adjudicator; private-initial ensemble; three independent all-evidence assessments plus adjudicator; unassisted single union probe without calculator. The latter diagnoses transfer beyond the calculator reference, not a no-tool treatment for all methods.
resources: Methods logically use 10 calls (3 shared initials charged to each method + 6 updates + 1 adjudicator). Single union uses 2; private ensemble 4 including shared initials; union ensemble 4; unassisted probe 1. These are lower-cost references, NOT equal-realized-compute comparisons. Report actual tokens/time, failures and shared-call accounting. No redundant calls solely to spend budget.
primary: Three complete paired system contrasts: delay within dedup, dedup within open, and their 2x2 interaction, each in posterior MAE and oracle-MAP direction. Average two complements and two origin conditions within each cell; 12 independent clusters and fixed 2000-resample descriptive percentile intervals. Per-origin group outcomes also retained.
secondary: Delayed dedup versus never, single union, private ensemble and union ensemble; agent transitions relative to the same union-evidence oracle; adjudicator pooling error; reported-probability consistency; no-calculator reference; actual resources. No sampled label Y, so no empirical accuracy or empirical Brier claim. Squared distance from known posterior is conditional excess expected Brier.
readiness: Zero format-invalid calls and assisted single-union posterior correctness and MAP consistency each >=95% of 48 scheduled reference calls. All primary paired means require 12 complete eligible cells; otherwise null.
developmental_stop: Pause further inference for discussion unless readiness and primary completeness pass AND delayed dedup reduces mean system MAE vs strong dedup-open by at least .01 with oracle-MAP direction loss <=.02. Fixed pilot go/no-go thresholds, not statistical superiority or equivalence. No adaptive sample extension, candidate switch or revised thresholds.
integrity: Freeze source/design before inference; no retries, substituted answers, missing-probability imputation or changed seeds. Invalid artifacts unavailable, not corrected; keep every scheduled output. Infrastructure failure stops run. Realistic identifiers, true origin records, and identical unique evidence checked before calls.
limitations: Synthetic known likelihood model and trusted provenance
Exact calculator supplies the main task posterior; this can saturate performance and restrict observable benefits
No general derivation verifier or imperfect ancestry test
Frozen initial reports, not full adaptive multi-agent debate
One model and 12 clusters; no significance or equivalence claims
Lower-cost utility controls are not exact compute-matched comparisons
Not native implementations of InfoDelphi, MAD or other published systems
A passed developmental rule would require a new frozen validation and natural-task transfer, not a top-tier publication claim

literature_review.design_implication: Retain no-peer reconsideration; distinguish operational peer-induced changes from latent conformity. No reproduction of that paper's reported rates.

InfoDelphi already studies evidence partitioning/routing, rationale exchange and forecast aggregation. Our exact provenance/copy controls differ but routing alone is not new. Our fixed binary harness is not a native implementation of its forecast pipeline.
Answer-dependent correctness confidence differs from our fixed-event P(Y=1); retain this semantic separation and avoid claiming confidence calibration from answer/probability consistency.
